package ui

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/egoist/mygo/internal/platform"
)

func TestOrbitComposerRangeEditUndoAndLiveCaret(t *testing.T) {
	for _, indexed := range []bool{false, true} {
		value := ""
		buffer := NewTextBuffer("")
		var saved TextKey
		var anchor, caret int
		tt := NewTester(func(c *Context) {
			var input Element
			if indexed {
				input = TextAreaBufferBase(c, buffer)
			} else {
				input = TextAreaBase(c, &value)
			}
			input.Fill().AutoFocus().OnTextKey(func(k TextKey) bool {
				if k.Key != KeyEnter {
					return false
				}
				saved = k
				anchor, caret = k.AnchorCaret()
				if k.Composing() {
					return true
				}
				return k.ReplaceRange(0, 10, "/review ")
			})
		}, 400, 200)
		text := func() string {
			if indexed {
				return buffer.String()
			}
			return value
		}
		// Queue text and navigation without a render. textKey.prepare must apply all
		// preceding native edits before exposing AnchorCaret and performing replace.
		tt.rt.event(platform.SurfaceEvent{Kind: platform.TextInput, Text: "/remainder 😀 arg"})
		for i := 0; i < 13; i++ {
			tt.rt.event(platform.SurfaceEvent{Kind: platform.KeyPressed, Key: platform.KeyLeft})
		}
		tt.rt.event(platform.SurfaceEvent{Kind: platform.KeyPressed, Key: platform.KeyEnter})
		tt.Frame()
		if anchor != 3 || caret != 3 || text() != "/review  😀 arg" {
			t.Fatalf("indexed=%v anchor/caret=%d/%d text=%q", indexed, anchor, caret, text())
		}
		ed := tt.rt.states[tt.rt.focused].editor
		if ed.caret != 8 {
			t.Fatalf("completion caret=%d", ed.caret)
		}
		tt.Key(Cmd, KeyZ)
		if text() != "/remainder 😀 arg" || ed.caret != 3 {
			t.Fatalf("indexed=%v undo=%q caret=%d", indexed, text(), ed.caret)
		}
		tt.Key(Cmd|Shift, KeyZ)
		if text() != "/review  😀 arg" || ed.caret != 8 {
			t.Fatalf("indexed=%v redo=%q caret=%d", indexed, text(), ed.caret)
		}
		tt.Type("next")
		tt.Key(Cmd, KeyZ)
		if text() != "/review  😀 arg" {
			t.Fatal("typing coalesced into completion", text())
		}
		func() {
			defer func() {
				if recover() == nil {
					t.Error("retained TextKey failed to reject lifetime misuse")
				}
			}()
			saved.AnchorCaret()
		}()
		tt.rt.close()
	}
}
func TestOrbitComposerPointerEditAndGuards(t *testing.T) {
	value := "/remainder 😀 args"
	replace, readOnly, disabled := false, false, false
	var changed bool
	var caret int
	tt := NewTester(func(c *Context) {
		input := TextAreaBase(c, &value).Fill().AutoFocus().ReadOnly(readOnly).Disabled(disabled)
		if replace {
			changed = input.ReplaceTextRange(0, 10, "/review ")
			replace = false
		}
		_, caret = input.TextAnchorCaret()
	}, 400, 200)
	replace = true
	tt.Frame()
	if !changed || value != "/review  😀 args" || caret != 8 {
		t.Fatal(value, caret, changed)
	}
	tt.Key(Cmd, KeyZ)
	if value != "/remainder 😀 args" {
		t.Fatal("pointer undo", value)
	}
	readOnly = true
	replace = true
	tt.Frame()
	if changed || value != "/remainder 😀 args" {
		t.Fatal("read only edit")
	}
	readOnly = false
	disabled = true
	replace = true
	tt.Frame()
	if changed {
		t.Fatal("disabled edit")
	}
	disabled = false
	tt.Frame()
	tt.Compose("你好", 2)
	replace = true
	tt.Frame()
	if changed || value != "/remainder 😀 args" {
		t.Fatal("IME edit", value, changed)
	}
	tt.rt.close()
}
func TestOrbitComposerRangeEditReversedSelectionAndClamping(t *testing.T) {
	value := "a😀bc"
	apply := false
	var anchor, caret int
	tt := NewTester(func(c *Context) {
		input := TextAreaBase(c, &value).Fill().AutoFocus()
		if apply {
			input.SetTextSelection(4, 1)
			if !input.ReplaceTextRange(1, 3, "文") {
				t.Fatal("replacement refused")
			}
			apply = false
		}
		anchor, caret = input.TextAnchorCaret()
	}, 400, 200)
	apply = true
	tt.Frame()
	if value != "a文c" || caret != 2 || anchor != 2 {
		t.Fatal(value, anchor, caret)
	}
	tt.Key(Cmd, KeyZ)
	if value != "a😀bc" || caret != 1 || anchor != 4 {
		t.Fatal("selection undo", value, anchor, caret)
	}
	tt.rt.close()
}
